headline: Tesla plans to start selling Cybercab robotaxis by year end
summary: Tesla says it will begin selling its driverless, steering-wheel-less Cybercab before the end of the year and expand the rollout to more US cities, even as federal regulators review the vehicle's safety and Tesla withholds its paid-ride numbers. Reports differ on whether the buyers are individual customers or other transport companies.
